lines.t: Verse 1
In quiet pages, fire speaks
Ancient words, yet alive in me
Every line like a river wide
Washing fear I once held inside
Verse 2
I believed shadows of who You were
Distant, silent, hard to discern
But Your voice broke through the lies
Love revealed before my eyes
Chorus
Oh, what a bounty of riches we have in Your Word
Treasures of heaven in every verse
Breaking the chains, setting hearts free
Showing the truth of who You are to me
Now my soul sings, I’ve tasted and seen
You are better than all I dreamed
Let the whole world come and see
This love, this grace, this mystery
Verse 3
Every promise, a living flame
Calling me deeper in Your name
Not just letters, but breath and life
Turning darkness into light
Verse 4
Modern words and ancient streams
Flow together in holy harmony
Speaking truth that restores the soul
Making the wounded spirit whole
Chorus
Oh, what a bounty of riches we have in Your Word
Treasures of heaven in every verse
Breaking the chains, setting hearts free
Showing the truth of who You are to me
Now my soul sings, I’ve tasted and seen
You are better than all I dreamed
Let the whole world come and see
This love, this grace, this mystery
Bridge
Let every nation hear the call
Every heart, both great and small
To know You fully, face to face
To be undone by Your embrace
No more fear, no more disguise
Only truth that satisfies
You are near, You are real
More than words could ever reveal
Final Chorus
Oh, what a bounty of riches we have in Your Word
A living voice that still is heard
Calling the lost, awakening hearts
Drawing Your children back to Your heart
Now my life is forever changed
By the power of Your holy name
Let the whole world come and see
And receive You completely
Outro
Overflowing, my heart will sing
Of the love that changes everything
